payload.title: Retire the GROBID citation stubs and let a monitor bring a machine-archived Reference back
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-03 approved archiving all 4,436 GROBID-created References on Machines on Machines (2,385 with no URL, 2,051 with one; all pending, no human input). New CLI command with --dry-run. Intake reuses any canonical URL match whatever its status (monitoring_intake.py), so an archived stub would silently hide a paper a monitor finds; a machine-archived match must return to pending. A human's archive or rejection stays.
